name: OCS expression language and filters
plain: Parameters and filters can be written as small expressions in OCS's own language, read by its own parser, not by Python. Calls into torch are off unless an environment variable allows them; with them off, a workflow's expressions can only use the built-in functions.
math:
Pratt parser over the expression text; handlers for arithmetic, comparisons and t_* tensor functions.
unsafe_tensor_method and unsafe_torch refuse unless COMFYUI_OCS_ALLOW_UNSAFE_EXPRESSIONS or COMFYUI_OCS_ALLOW_ALL_UNSAFE is set.
